log.msg: Answered the permutation question before building: gen() is NOT an enumerator — a fixed skeleton, two families, ~3k reachable strings but only two structural shapes, so the seed never varies the nesting. A depth-0-10 recursive generator WILL reach mostly-broken layouts, because this format's three silent words are position-sensitive and depth multiplies exactly them (scroll one level too deep never engages, stick on a stretched rail does nothing, fluid inverts against flex-1 in a wrapping row). Mike's call: ship the slider raw, no score and no guard rails — broken rolls are the honest output of a search. LayoutTool scoring stays phase 2.

Do not rebuild the Panel seam: ext/Panel/generate.js already has structure(seed) (spec → detached Panel tree, pure) and sow(item, seed), wired as a space_dashboard button on EVERY panel bar (toolbar.js:46, workspace.js:193). Rerolling one section independently already works. The delta is threading depth through it and giving it a home on the space page — Mike chose a new space/compose/ tab over replacing the ruler's five shots.

The permutation answer, confirmed by building it: depth turns a curated sampler into a search over a mostly-invalid space, and past depth 4 most rolls are slivers. Shipped raw per Mike. Two bounds are in that are NOT guard rails and are labelled as such — CAP at 80 boxes (a fresh depth per child can branch faster than it shrinks, and five shots plus twelve tiles render at once), and a fixed --basis only on a LEAF (a fixed container collapses its children through ext/Panel share()).

assign.outcome:
**Depth, panels and translucent blocks** — [Space](/framework/styles/layouts/space/) · [Compose](/framework/styles/layouts/space/compose/) · [Words](/framework/styles/layouts/space/words/)

The five detail buttons are a **Depth slider 0–10** (max nesting); the generator is recursive now and every top-level section draws its own depth from 0 to the max. Blocks paint with a new **tone** spec word — translucent oklch, so two boxes deep composites darker than one and nesting is readable; --tone is a hue that INHERITS, so a section is a colour scheme rather than a rainbow.

**compose/** is a real ext/Panel workspace from structure(seed, depth): every block is a panel and any section rerolls independently from its own bar. Almost none of that was new — structure()/sow() and the per-bar roll already existed; the delta was threading depth (on root.depth, instance state) and giving it a page.

Four measured bugs, all documented where they bite: notes was in the spec PARTS but not in the translator PANELS map, so a third of every rolled workspace drew checkerboard (the exact trap ext/Panel readme already named); a fill page has no height inside a Doc tab; --panel-height:100% resolves against an auto parent; and a fixed --basis CONTAINER collapsed its children to ~20px because share() makes a basis a fraction, not a minimum — leaves-only took compose from F 8 to D 64.

compose/ now scores in the same band as /framework/ext/Panel/ itself at every width. Clean console at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440.
